column4: Participated in US Congressional Carbon Policy and Pricing Lobby Day
Organized and issued statement to support passage of Great American Outdoors Act (S.3422) to permanently fund the Land & Water
Conservation Fund, which was passed into law in August 2020
Participated in statement in support of the Growing Climate Solutions Act under consideration in the US Congress
Filed submission to the EU public consultation on the review of the Non-Financial Reporting Directive
Filed submission to the EU public consultation on the Renewed Sustainable Finance Strategy
Submitted Trillion Tree pledge; joined US Trillion Tree stakeholder committee
Joined letter in support of increasing EU 2030 GHG emissions reduction target to at least 55 percent net GHG emission reductions
Joined Corporate Leaders Group Europe to advocate for progressive public policy that supports progress towards net zero in Europe
Participated in letter in support of American Energy Innovation Act (later named Energy Act of 2020)
Joined Water Europe to advocate for smart water policies in the EU
Participated in letter to Virginia SCC to require utility to incorporate more cost-effective clean energy in its investment plan
Submitted comments to EU public consultation on “Empowering the consumer for the green transition”
Filed comments to US Federal Energy Regulatory Commission in support of FERC issuing policy guidance on integrating state carbon
